name: grill
description: Grill your decisions: an outside AI judge, from a different company than your chat assistant, argues the strongest case against a decision or forecast and names the tests that would settle it. Includes a weekly decision review. Bring your own OpenRouter key and connections.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Create one at https://openrouter.ai/keys and add a few dollars of credit; a grill costs about a cent. It is masked, stored securely, and sent only to OpenRouter. Or leave it empty if OPENROUTER_API_KEY is already set in your environment.

jev_quality_check.title: Quality check with Jev
jev_quality_check.description: Also score each grill with Jev (TypeSafe, a zero-retention decision model on OpenRouter): are the falsifiers concrete, does the verdict fit? TypeSafe then also sees your masked write-up. About $0.0002 a grill.
